caption: The drawing depicts a doll-like figure with an elongated head and neck, a narrow oval-shaped face, and thin arms. The figure has long, black hair styled up with a blue hair ornament and a thin black ribbon or string with a curve extending upward and to the right. The face features minimal details, including two round eyes, straight eyebrows, a small nose, and a simple line for a mouth. The figure is dressed in a long, wide-skirted dress. The dress is predominantly light purple with two vertical bands running down the skirt, each band decorated with alternating red, orange, black, and white geometric patterns resembling circles and diamonds. The bodice is fitted and light purple, and there is a blue choker or ribbon around the neck. The sleeves are short, and the left arm is bent at an angle. The figure is positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background with no other objects or elements present.
title: Rag Doll Bodice
